Companion Animal Travel Desk handling rules

This section sets the basic handling rules for pets moving through Aurelia Skyways. Staff keep care plans current, check comfort needs, and log any service change in the desk ledger. <<FACT F001>> Cats, dogs, and other approved animals stay in the care lane until review is done. Each traveler gets calm handling, clean water, and a clear handoff between staff.

When a pet relief stop is needed, the desk follows local access steps and keeps the area tidy after use. <<FACT F017>> Staff also watch for stress, noise, and heat, and they slow the process if a pet shows signs of strain. <<FACT F007>> If a case needs extra support, contact the welfare coordinator or the shift lead right away for the next step.
